title: Mint a token.
lede: Launch an ERC-20 on BNB Smart Chain, a standard Solana SPL token, or a genuine Pump.fun coin. You sign every transaction in your own wallet, and nothing is shown as live until the chain confirms it.

modes.title: Three launch modes
modes.subtitle: Each one follows its own chain's rules.
modes.footnote: No hidden taxes, no upgradeable proxies, no admin backdoors.
